changes: Now Zac Kyoti's own final source, unchanged; the gesture and the LIVE REC messages work as before.
Switching the setting redraws PERSONALIZE only while that page is open.
Tested by the author on an MKI from the card: the gesture, the PERSONALIZE redraw and a power cycle.
Known issue: this version is not yet tested over USB, on an MKII, with grid recording or on MIDI tracks.
First Modwerk release of Zac-Kyoti’s QUANTIZE LIVE REC gesture, listed as Quant Live Rec.
Hold [REC] and tap [PLAY] to show LIVE REC: QUANTIZED or UNQUANTIZED; tap [PLAY] again while it shows to switch. The first [REC] + [PLAY] still starts live recording.
Modwerk rewords the messages and keeps an open PERSONALIZE list in step when you switch.
Available over USB on the Modwerk beta base. The setting is kept across power cycles and Part or project reloads.
Known issue: not yet tested on the MKI, with grid recording or on MIDI tracks.
